title: Weak-blockade C5/C8 gate viability: is a 0.99-fidelity two-qubit phase gate possible near the C6 zero?

c5_at_zero_ghz_um5.anchored_to: E4 direct quadrupole-quadrupole matrix element <aa|V_QQ|aa> R^5 at theta=24.65 deg (V_QQ = -C5/R^5); reproduced verbatim from E4 results.json computed.c5_at_zero_ghz_um5
c5_at_zero_ghz_um5.quote: computed.c5_at_zero_ghz_um5 = -0.126 GHz um^5 (E4 results.json, quadrupole_floor.json key 24.65)

c8_at_zero_ghz_um8.anchored_to: E4 second-order dipole-quadrupole perturbation sum over 4200 channels (n_range 58-62, l 0-3) at theta=24.65 deg (V_DQ = -C8/R^8); reproduced verbatim from E4 results.json computed.c8_at_zero_ghz_um8

rydberg_lifetime_tau_us.source: Low2012 (43S lifetime) scaled to n=60; Saffman2010 uses tau=100 us for Rb
rydberg_lifetime_tau_us.anchored_to: Low2012 43S: spontaneous-only 80.8 us, 42.3 us incl. 300 K blackbody; n^3 scaling to n=60 gives 80.8*(60/43)^3 = 220 us spontaneous; adding BBR (1/tau_bb ~ n^-2 scaled from Low2012) gives ~97 us total at 300 K, matching the field-standard tau=100 us.
rydberg_lifetime_tau_us.quote: Low2012 note: '43S lifetime 42.3 us incl. blackbody radiation (300 K) -> 3.76 kHz linewidth; spontaneous-only lifetime 80.8 us'; Saffman2010 note: '(omega_10/2pi=6834 MHz, tau=100 us)'.

ground_hyperfine_omega10_MHz.anchored_to: Saffman2010 interaction-gate bound E_min=(2^{7/2} pi/(tau omega_10))^{1/2} ~= 0.003 quoted for 87Rb (omega_10/2pi=6834 MHz, tau=100 us).
ground_hyperfine_omega10_MHz.quote: Saffman2010 note: 'interaction-gate lower bound E_min=(2^{7/2}pi/(tau omega_10))^{1/2}~=0.003 for 87Rb (omega_10/2pi=6834 MHz, tau=100 us)'.

target_pair.value: Rb 60P3/2 m=3/2 stretched pair (n=60, l=1, j=1.5, m=1.5), interatomic axis at theta*=24.3 deg where C6 ~ 0

quantities.observable: Maximum entanglement (process) fidelity of the two-atom controlled-Z gate (best of the pi-2pi-pi blockade gate and the pi-pi-hold-pi-pi interaction gate) over R in [1,5] um and Omega in [1,500] MHz, with the C5/C8 interaction at the C6 zero (C5=-0.126 GHz um^5, C8=+1.747 GHz um^8) and Rydberg lifetime tau=100 us. Reported at the reliable optimum R=2.0 um (the grid maximum 0.9994 at R=1.0 um sits at the unverified short-R multipole-expansion edge).
quantities.uncertainty_source: master-equation vs analytic Eq.34 agree to ~10% on the infidelity (0.0033 vs 0.0030 at R=2.0 um); Omega/R grid resolution (R step 0.2 um, Omega up to 2x) bounds the optimum location; uncomputed higher multipoles (C9+) and unswept C8 convergence at short R add model uncertainty

limit_check.observed: 0.9967 at R=2.0 um, Omega=160 MHz (interaction gate); 0.993 at R=2.2 um; collapses to ~0.41 in the R=2.4 um sign-crossing dead zone

quantities.observable: Minimum interaction shift |V| (regular MHz) required for fidelity >= 0.99, from the Saffman2016 fundamental bound E >= 2/(V tau) = 0.01 -> V >= 2/(0.01 tau) = 0.318 MHz at tau=100 us.
quantities.uncertainty_source: propagated from the tau=100 us lifetime uncertainty (~10%; the Rb 60P3/2 state is shorter-lived than the 60S anchor, which only raises this threshold and strengthens the NOT-viable conclusion in the sub-MHz regime)

quantities.observable: Largest atom separation (um) at which |V(R)| = |-C5/R^5 - C8/R^8| still exceeds the 0.318 MHz fundamental threshold; beyond this (and past the R=2.40 um sign crossing) |V| never recovers above 0.27 MHz.
quantities.uncertainty_source: sensitivity to the C8 value (E4 convergence unswept); C8 +/- 0.05 GHz um^8 shifts the crossing and the threshold radius by ~0.05 um

limit_check.limit: |V| >= 0.318 MHz holds only for R <= ~2.29 um
limit_check.observed: 2.2874 um; |V(R=2.2)=0.74 MHz|, |V(R=2.4)~0|, max |V| for R>2.4 is 0.27 MHz at R~2.8 um (below threshold)

quantities.observable: Maximum gate fidelity (best of blockade + interaction gate) restricted to the genuinely sub-MHz regime R >= 2.5 um where |V| <= 0.25 MHz (the 'sub-MHz at 2-3 um' regime the follow-up described).
quantities.uncertainty_source: grid resolution and C8 convergence uncertainty

limit_check.limit: fidelity < 0.99 in the sub-MHz regime (R >= 2.5 um)

premise_corrections.premise: FollowUp framing: near the C6 zero the interaction is dominated by C5/C8 and is 'sub-MHz at 2-3 um'.
premise_corrections.corrected: The C8/R^8 term makes the interaction few-MHz at R=2.0 um (V=-2.89 MHz), NOT sub-MHz; V(R) crosses zero at R=2.402 um (dead zone where C5 and C8 cancel), and is sub-MHz (|V| <= 0.27 MHz) only for R >= 2.4 um.
premise_corrections.consequence: The viable gate configurations (F>=0.99) live at R <= 2.2 um (|V| >= 0.7 MHz), not in the sub-MHz regime. The sub-MHz regime (R >= 2.5 um) is explicitly NOT viable (F <= 0.98).

computed.acceptance_criterion: Existence/optimization. Sweep R in [1,5] um and Omega in [1,500] MHz at the C5/C8 interaction (C5=-0.126 GHz um^5, C8=+1.747 GHz um^8 at theta*~=24.3 deg), tau=100 us. Let F_max = computed.cz_gate_max_fidelity. VIABLE iff F_max >= 0.99; NOT VIABLE iff F_max < 0.99. Single-fault guards (the fidelity observable must respond): (a) with V=0 (no interaction) the CZ entanglement fidelity must collapse to ~0.25 (no entangling power); (b) with tau->inf and strong interaction the fidelity must approach 1. Both guards were checked and passed (F=0.2502 no-interaction, F=0.9999999 strong no-decay).

method_blocked_resolved.resolves: tool_review independent test-authorship agent (adversarial pytest for cz_gate_fidelity and gate_error_budget)
method_blocked_resolved.disclosure: Independent adversarial pytest files were not produced (tool_review quota, HTTP 429). cz_gate_fidelity was verified against pre-registered analytic degenerate limits (no-interaction entanglement fidelity F_e=0.25, strong-blockade F_e approaching 1) and cross-validated against the Saffman-Walker-Moelmer Eq. (34) analytic gate-error budget, agreeing to about 10 percent on the infidelity across R=2.0-3.0 um. gate_error_budget was verified by closed-form recomputation and the E lower bound 2/(V tau) fundamental limit.
